question: Can the independently branded Blender 5.2 fork embed the frozen typed SceneSpec v0.1 contract, produce BuildPlan bytes canonical-exact with the existing external compiler, expose the proposal diff and approval scope before execution, build B01/B02 in isolated roots, and reject invalid or unapproved inputs before scene mutation?
hypothesis: A small additive Python contract module plus Film Studio UI bridge can preserve the external B01/B02 compiler identities without accepting arbitrary generated Python or weakening path, schema, hash or approval boundaries.
acceptance: External and embedded serialized B01 BuildPlan files are byte-exact and equal the frozen file SHA-256, byte count and planHash.
External and embedded serialized B02 BuildPlan files are byte-exact and equal the frozen file SHA-256, byte count and planHash.
The embedded entry accepts only a typed proposal plus a separately hash-bound approval and executes no proposal-supplied Python, shell or network operation.
The Film Studio UI displays the proposal diff and exact approval scope before the execute control is enabled.
B01 and B02 each build once in a distinct absent-before-run artifact root and reproduce the frozen canonical structure hash.
All four preregistered negative cases return their exact reason before a BuildPlan write or scene mutation.

The official Blender configuration root remains byte-exact, no more than one product process runs concurrently, no more than five formal product starts occur, and the gate-owned non-generated source addition stays at or below 900 lines.
stopRules: If free bytes are below 171798691840 before a native build or product start, record BLOCKED and start no new native process.
If the embedded compiler needs arbitrary generated Python, shell access, network access or broader approval than WRITE_BUILD_PLAN, record FAIL.

If either canonical comparison, isolated structure build, UI ordering, configuration isolation, patch ceiling or any negative control fails after formal-start.json is frozen, preserve evidence and record FAIL without same-ID repair.
Implementation and compile diagnostics before formal-start.json are development work; preserve them in development-log.json and do not count them as a formal scientific run.
claimCeiling: F0.4 can prove only typed SceneSpec v0.1 contract embedding, B01/B02 canonical parity, bounded approval visibility and pre-mutation rejection on this product build. It does not prove arbitrary-scene coverage, model quality, rendering receipts, merge cost, packaging, signing or production readiness.
